title: Multi-modal
guidingQuestion: How do text, audio, video, and devices work as one experience?
summary: Seamless multimodal experiences so information is not trapped in a single medium or device silo.
webProblem: Text, audio, video, and devices remain siloed

hero.headline: Meaning should move across senses and devices.
hero.text: A conversation starts in chat, continues on a call, and ends as a document. Multimodal Meta-Layer design keeps context intact across those shifts.

problemStory.title: Why this matters
problemStory.scenario: A blind user cannot access a critical video update. A meeting recording never links back to the decision thread. Each medium is a dead end.

currentChallenges: Weak captions and transcripts as first-class objects
No shared multimodal identity of a conversation

webLimitations.title: Why today's Web struggles
webLimitations.text: Products specialize by medium because media stacks and business units are separate. Continuity across modalities is an afterthought.

futureVision.title: Imagine instead
futureVision.text: A single collaborative thread can be spoken, read, watched, or felt across devices without losing provenance or participants.

audiences.label: Educators
audiences.why: Teach across media without losing the thread.

exampleDomains.label: Education
exampleDomains.text: Lessons that move from video to text to practice.

exampleDomains.label: Meetings
exampleDomains.text: Decisions linked across recording and notes.
